bio: China-AI commentator on X. Tracks Chinese AI development, frontier model releases, and the geopolitical dimensions of the global AI race. Known for sharp, often sardonic observations on the motivations and implications of Chinese AI labs — particularly DeepSeek — and their relationship to Western AI incumbents.
notable_themes: Frontier model capabilities and release dynamics
Geopolitics of AI and chip export controls
Motivations and incentives of Chinese AI founders
